standard-dialogue-before-spirits-of-the-.npc: True. We've not fallen on the best of times here.

standard-dialogue-before-spirits-of-the-.player: Any way that I can help?

standard-dialogue-before-spirits-of-the-.npc: Possibly. I'd go talk to Awusah the Mayor of Nardah. He's in the big house on the east side of the town square.

standard-dialogue-after-spirits-of-the-e.player: How's life now the curse has been lifted?

standard-dialogue-after-spirits-of-the-e.npc: Much better thanks to you. We're all very impressed.
